name: MNEE Limited
summary: Antigua and Barbuda company that issues and redeems MNEE for verified customers and states that it operates under Digital Asset Business licence DAB No. A00003, Class A.
notes: PR #498 organization record. Legal entity, licence representation, issuance, redemption, and reserve obligations are sourced to current issuer terms; independent regulator-record details and licence-effective date remain reviewable.

name: Bison Bank, S.A.
summary: Portuguese credit institution and legal issuer of the EUB and USB electronic-money tokens for pre-approved institutional partners under the reviewed MiCA whitepapers and product terms.
notes: PR #517 shared issuer record. Bison Bank is recorded as the legal issuer, issuance and redemption counterparty, and operator of the approved-partner workflow for EUB and USB. Issuer-level audit statements are not treated as token-specific reserve assurance.

name: JPYR Organization
summary: Name presented on the current JPYR project website for the organization behind JPYR. The direct project site strengthens the brand/operator identity boundary but still does not establish the exact incorporated legal issuer, incorporation jurisdiction, reserve owner, or legal redemption obligor.
notes: Do not treat the descriptive JPYR Organization label or jpyr.org branding as proof of a separately incorporated legal issuer. Legal identity, jurisdiction, reserve manager, redemption obligor and formal regulatory status remain unresolved.
